docs.title: Returns: sarees and apparel
passages: Sarees, kurtas and other apparel can be returned within 7 days of delivery, provided the tags are intact and the item is unused. Start a return from the Orders page in your account.
Custom-stitched blouses added to a saree order are tailored to your measurements and are final sale, not eligible for return or exchange even within the standard 7-day window.
Items bought during a clearance or end-of-season sale are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged, whatever their condition.

docs.title: Returns: home textiles and damaged items
passages: Bedsheets, dohars and cushion covers can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery if the packaging seal is unbroken. Used home textiles cannot be returned for hygiene reasons.
If your saree or any other item arrives damaged or wrong, upload a photo of it within 48 hours of delivery from the Orders page and we will replace it free of cost.

docs.title: Hand block-printing and fabric care
passages: Every bagru and dabu print is dyed by hand in small batches, so tones vary from one piece to the next and from what the catalogue shows. This is a mark of hand processing, not a defect.
Wash hand block-printed sarees in cold water, separately, for the first three washes. Natural dyes release a little colour early on.
Do not dry hand block-printed sarees and bedsheets in direct sunlight for long; natural dyes fade faster under harsh light.
Do not dry-clean hand-dyed items with bleach-based solvents, which strip natural colour faster than a gentle machine wash.

docs.title: Shipping and delivery
passages: Standard delivery takes 4 to 7 working days across India; metro pin codes usually see delivery in 3 to 4 days.
Cash on delivery is available on orders under Rs 5,000, and prepaid orders over Rs 2,000 ship free.
Once an order is dispatched, tracking details are sent by SMS and email and can also be checked on the Orders page.
International shipping is not available yet; Kumkum Home ships only within India.

docs.title: Sizes and measurements
passages: The block-print bedsheet comes in queen (90 x 100 in) and king (108 x 108 in) sizes, each with two pillow covers.
A standard saree blouse piece is 0.8 metres and comes unstitched unless custom stitching is added at checkout.

docs.title: Brass diyas and decor
passages: Brass diyas tarnish naturally with air exposure; a soft cloth with a little lemon and salt brings back the shine without chemical cleaners.
Brass diyas are handmade, so small differences in finish and weight between pieces are expected.

docs.title: Orders, cancellations and refunds
passages: Orders can be cancelled free of charge before dispatch; after dispatch the order cannot be cancelled and must be returned after delivery instead.
If you are charged twice for the same order, the duplicate charge is refunded automatically within 5 to 7 working days once the bank confirms it.
Refunds for cancelled orders go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 working days.

docs.title: Gifting and festive orders
passages: Gift orders can include a handwritten note added at checkout; price tags and invoices are left out of gift packaging.
Festive orders placed after 20 October may not arrive before Diwali; check the estimated delivery date at checkout during peak season.
